title: The Kecksburg UFO Incident
hook: In December 1965, a fireball crashed near Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, and officials sealed the site.

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: On December 9, 1965, residents reported a bright fireball streaking across the sky over Kecksburg.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Witnesses said the object landed in a wooded field, leaving a large, circular indent.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: The military arrived that night, cordoned the area, and removed unknown debris before dawn.

beats.label: CLUE 3
beats.line: Local newspaper articles later claimed the recovered material resembled a metallic alloy not known to industry.

beats.label: THEORY
beats.line: One theory says it was a Soviet satellite, others claim a secret US test.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: In 2005, a former Air Force officer said the debris remained classified.

end.line: What really crashed in Kecksburg, and why was it hidden?

description: Explore the baffling 1965 Kecksburg crash and the lingering mysteries.

facts.claim: A fireball was reported over Kecksburg on December 9, 1965.
The object allegedly landed in a wooded field, creating a circular indentation.
Military personnel cordoned the area and removed debris overnight.
Local newspapers described the recovered material as an unknown metallic alloy.
A former Air Force officer claimed the debris remained classified as of 2005.
facts.source: UFO Magazine, 2005 interview with Lt. Col. Robert R.
